semiconductor_relevance: High — FRD Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing and selling special gases used in semiconductor processes, making it a key player in the materials supply chain.
summary: FRD Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of specialty gases tailored for semiconductor, solar, display, and LED applications. The company focuses on technology development and customer customization to meet the evolving needs of the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Manufacturing of specialty gases for semiconductor processes
Supply of rare and noble gases
Development of gas mixtures for specific applications
technical_expertise: Material science for gas purity and composition
Process optimization for gas applications in semiconductor fabrication
